visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-02-13
Patient: 63-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: sudden severe low back pain with leg weakness
Seen in the emergency department.
History: pain began this morning; new difficulty passing urine and numbness around the saddle area.
Examination: reduced perineal sensation; weakness in both legs.
Assessment: suspected cauda equina syndrome.
Plan: emergency MRI of the lumbar spine, carried out in the department.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-02-13.

expected.rationale: The claim's place of service is 23 and the note records that the scan was done in the emergency department, where the policy requires no authorization.
